Name: Stardew Valley Reimagined 3
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[b][color=#ffff00]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/color][/b]

[b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][color=#b4a7d6]14/11/26 update:  [/color][color=#ffffff]version 2.0 should work with Stardew 1.6[/color][/size][/font][/b]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][color=#b4a7d6][b]★[/b][/color][color=#ffffff] you will need to use [url=https://github.com/Lake1059/ResetTerrainFeatures_NET6/releases/download/1.0.3-unofficial.3-Lake1059/SDV_1.6.0-1.6.8_RTF-1.0.3-unofficial.3-Lake1059.zip]this mod[/url] to reset [i]trees[/i] and [i]bushes[/i] on the [i]bus stop[/i], [i]town[/i], and [i]forest [/i]maps[b] [/b][/color][/size][/font]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][color=#b4a7d6][b]★ [/b][/color][/size][/font][color=#ffffff][size=2][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]see changelog below for more info  (includes spoilers for 1.6 content)[/font][/size][/color]
[spoiler][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][color=#ffffff]✔️ added bookseller[/color][/size][/font][/b]
[b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][color=#ffffff]✔️ added racoon tree stump[/color][/size][/font][/b]
[b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][color=#ffffff]✔️ added mastery cave door[/color][/size][/font][/b]
[b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][color=#ffffff]✔️ added hidden items to town
✔️ removed premature summit access[/color][/size][/font][/b]
[b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][color=#ffffff]✔️ fixed broken maps + warps[/color][/size][/font][/b]
[b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][color=#ffffff]✔️ fixed broken npc schedules + events[/color][/size][/font]
[/b]
[b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][color=#ffffff] ✖️ even-year festival map variants not included; they will be vanilla[/color][/size][/font][/b]
[b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][color=#ffffff]✖️ i have not done extensive testing, only confirmed that major bugs have been fixed[/color][/size][/font][/b][/spoiler]
[b][color=#ffff00]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- [/color][/b]

[b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][color=#b4a7d6]★[/color] Yup, another one!! This works with Stardew Valley 1.5 and has a cleaner look than the previous iterations. It's also got new maps! [color=#b4a7d6]★[/color]
 
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GdasZDr.png[/img][/size][/font]
[/b]
[list]
[*][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]All outdoor maps redesigned + 4 new ones[/size][/font][/b][/*]
[*][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]70+ location messages on objects throughout the world[/size][/font][/b][/*]
[*][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Special forage areas that spawn uncommon and rare items[/size][/font][/b][/*]
[*][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]A lot more hardwood stumps, trees, and berry bushes[/size][/font][/b][/*]
[*][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Access to previous inaccessible, unused areas[/size][/font][/b][/*]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2] 
 
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tpY0bg7.png[/img]
 [/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]All maps can be enabled and disabled individually in the [color=#d9d2e9]config.json[/color] file, so you can pick and choose which ones you want![/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]The file can be found in the [color=#d9d2e9][CP] Stardew Valley Reimagined 3[/color] folder and opened with any text editor, e.g. Notepad[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]If the file is not there, run the game with SMAPI once to generate it[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Open the file, make your changes, save, then relaunch the game[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2] 
 
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WRQ6OpX.png[/img]
 [/size][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]If necessary, remove any items you've placed around town[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Download this mod and also the [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-64#post-43678][color=#e69138][b]Reset Terrain Features[/b][/color][/url]﻿ mod[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Make changes to this mod's config file now if there are some maps you want to disable[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Load up your save then press the L key to reset trees, bushes, grass, and debris on each map[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]If you've unlocked the special orders board and a bush regrows over it, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304][b][color=#e69138]Destroyable Bushes[/color][/b][/url]﻿ to remove it[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Save the game by sleeping so you don't have to do all that again[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][b] [/b]
[b] [/b]
[b] [/b]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/2chWo75.png[/img][/b][/size][/font]
[color=#93c47d][b]
﻿  ✓[/b][/color][b] indoor maps, farm maps
[color=#93c47d][b]﻿  ✓[/b][/color][b] most [/b]recolours (Earthy, Eemie, Starblue, Wittily Named, Vibrant Pastoral)
[color=#93c47d]  ✓ [/color]Ridgeside Valley (disable its PoleAtBackwoods option and this mod's FestivalMaps option)
[b][color=#93c47d]  ✓[/color] Walk to the Desert Redux (disable this mod's bus stop)
[b][color=#93c47d]  ✓[/color] Way Back Pelican Town (requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10908]patch[/url])[/b][/b]
[color=#93c47d]  ✓[/color] Boarding House Bus Stop Extension
[color=#93c47d]  ✓[/color] East Scarp
[b][color=#93c47d]  ✓[/color] DeepWoods[/b]
[color=#e06666]  ✗[/color] Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]
